description:
Get the list of queries associated with an eDiscovery review set.

TIP: Lists saved queries (filters) on a review set. Each query has displayName, contentQuery (KQL filtering review-set items), createdDateTime. Queries are the persistent way to slice a review set — examples: 'all items tagged Responsive', 'docs from a specific custodian', 'communications matching keyword X'.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.

name: list-review-set-queries
